newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 75 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 75 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 75 points in early morning trading Thursday, as the market got a big boost from the strong opening in the stock of trendsetter, International Business Machines Corp., which reported upbeat earnings late on Wednesday.
At 9:56 a.m. EDT, the Dow was up 75.46 points at 6,888.18, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
